mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, it triggers a hawkish policy response that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong labor market and consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between UNRATE and RSAFS shows negative Rank IC (<0.03) over any 3-year window or positive returns don't materialize when both series move as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market slowdowns (declining new home construction), consumer spending weakens, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST decline periods or Rank IC for HOUST in this regime is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate consistently signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index base 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100 periods or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with slowing retail sales (RSAFS) indicates monetary tightening dampening consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak consumer demand
failure_condition: Interaction term between FEDFUNDS and RSAFS shows positive Rank IC (>0.03) or negative returns don't occur when both series move as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: During early economic recovery phases, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing output that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO rise periods during early recovery or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in this regime.
